subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): guard assertHttpUrlTargetsPrivateNetwork against malformed URLs

question: Should the public Plugin SDK helper intentionally remove Node's native invalid-URL `input` and error identity while preserving only `TypeError`, `ERR_INVALID_URL`, and the stable message?
rationale: The patch resolves credential reflection without a correctness defect, but only maintainers can authorize the compatibility boundary for third-party plugins consuming this public SDK error.

options.title: Approve sanitized contract
options.body: Accept the security hardening and document `TypeError` plus `ERR_INVALID_URL` as the supported malformed-URL classification contract.

options.title: Preserve native behavior
options.body: Pause or close the PR if compatibility with native parser metadata is considered more important than eliminating structured rejected-input exposure.

recommendation.title: Approve sanitized contract
recommendation.body: Accept the security hardening and document `TypeError` plus `ERR_INVALID_URL` as the supported malformed-URL classification contract.
